description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for session and tenant management, including listing tenants, setting active tenants, and toggling global tenant visibility. It handles authorization, audit logging, and cookie setting for tenant context.

methods.name: /api/session/tenants [GET]
methods.description: Handles listing tenants accessible to the current authenticated user, with audit log entry.

methods.name: /api/session/tenant [POST]
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the session, with validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: /api/tenants/select [POST]
methods.description: Alias route for selecting a tenant, routed to the '/tenant' POST handler.

methods.name: /api/session/all-tenants [POST]
methods.description: Enables or disables global tenant scope for the session (Super Admin only), with audit logging.
